about_the_game:
Disclaimer: Purchase of this base game includes the first chapter. Future chapters will be released as DLC.

Try to stay alive in this first-person horror experience.

Explore a decaying post-apocalyptic world. Solve twisted puzzles. Avoid what lurks beyond the trees. And uncover the truth about who you are—or what you’ve become.

Welcome to the world after the Blackout.

The year is 2005. Civilization has crumbled after a global energy collapse known as the Blackout. Scattered survivors cling to life in underground bunkers, sealed away from the horrors that roam the surface.

You are R2-P23H, an autonomous maintenance unit assigned to Bunker 01, deep within a forgotten forest.

A man speaks to you through a monitor, giving you orders. But the forest feels… alive.
Something out there is watching. Something that doesn’t want you here.

Are you just a machine?

You were built to obey. To maintain. To survive.

But the forest remembers something you’ve forgotten.
You dream. You hesitate. You listen when it calls your name.

And somewhere, deep inside… You know you weren’t meant to.

Features

  • Atmospheric first-person horror with light survival mechanics

  • Puzzles woven into exploration and narrative

  • Hidden secrets that reshape your understanding of the story

  • Tense stealth sections—stay quiet, stay low, stay breathing

  • Creeping dread and psychological horror, rather than jumpscare overload

  • Chapter-based story with future expansions planned

Step outside. The dark is waiting.

Are you ready to see what’s left of the world?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains scenes of mild violence and suspenseful horror elements.

Players may experience intense moments of fear, including being pursued and attacked by hostile entities.

There are no depictions of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm.

name: In The Dark

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11800H or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 with DirectX 12 and Shader Model 6.0 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device

short_description: In The Dark is a first-person horror game set in a post-apocalyptic 2005. You are R2-P23H, a maintenance robot stationed in a remote forest bunker. But something is watching you. And maybe… you're not just a machine after all.
